title: USACE flies UAS in support of Hurricane Ian recovery
description: Tom Spencer, U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Jacksonville District, remote sensing program manager / project engineer, flies a drone over Fort Myers Beach, Florida, Oct. 11, to gather data on storm damage following Hurricane Ian’s landfall Sept. 28. Spencer is one of more than 280 USACE employees deployed to Florida that are actively supporting FEMA and the state’s recovery operations.
keywords: FEMA, jacksonville district, Ian, Hurricane Ian, HurricaneIan22, USACE
unit_name: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Jacksonville District
